questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Anatomy. which chamber pumps oxygenated blood into the aorta?
questions.explanation: The left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood into systemic circulation.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Physiology. the primary function of haemoglobin is to:
questions.explanation: Haemoglobin in red blood cells binds and transports oxygen.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Training. progressive overload means:
questions.explanation: Progressive overload applies a gradual increase in training stress.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Training. the FITT principle stands for:
questions.explanation: FITT is a framework for planning exercise programmes.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Yoga. which practice is primarily a breathing technique?
questions.explanation: Pranayama refers to regulation of breath.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Sports Psychology. intrinsic motivation comes from:
questions.explanation: Intrinsic motivation arises from interest or enjoyment in the activity.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biomechanics. the ability to maintain body position is called:
questions.explanation: Balance is the ability to maintain stability.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Sports Injuries. the immediate first-aid approach for a minor acute sprain commonly includes:
questions.explanation: Protecting the injury and managing swelling are appropriate early steps; serious injuries need assessment.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Nutrition. which nutrient is the body’s main quick energy source?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are a major readily available energy source.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Fitness Testing. a sit-and-reach test mainly assesses:
questions.explanation: The test estimates flexibility of the lower back and hamstrings.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Training. a warm-up is intended to:

options.A: Prepare the body gradually for activity

questions.explanation: A warm-up raises readiness and prepares muscles and cardiovascular function.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Sports Psychology. arousal that is too high may:
questions.explanation: Excessive arousal can reduce concentration and coordination.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Biomechanics. a third-class lever has the:
questions.explanation: In a third-class lever, effort is applied between fulcrum and resistance.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Sports Management. a round-robin tournament ensures that:

options.A: Each team plays every other team
options.C: Teams are eliminated after one loss

questions.explanation: In a single round-robin, each participant meets every other participant once.
questions.subject: Physical Education

questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 12 learner is reviewing Health. hydration is important because water helps:

options.A: Regulate temperature and support body functions

questions.explanation: Water supports thermoregulation, transport and normal physiological processes.
questions.subject: Physical Education
